title: PlaybackSessionStatusChangedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'playback.session-status-changed' (d3-e5, browser-admin-F2 follow-up). Emitted whenever a playback session's NON-TERMINAL status moves — the segment-ahead throttle parking/resuming a transcode (docs/PLAYBACK.md §9), a seek claiming its target, the worker's pipeline reaching starting/active, or a restart clearing a throttle park. The terminal transitions are NOT here: reaching ended/failed already emits playback.ended, and a second event for the same moment would make an admin surface race itself. ADMIN-ONLY delivery (packages/shared/src/admin-only-event-types.ts): a playback session's operational state is instance administration, and the only consumers are the two admin now-playing surfaces. Deliberately TRANSPORT-ONLY — no itemId, userId or deviceId — so there is nothing for a viewer-scoped visibility predicate to gate on (packages/db/src/query/events.ts): unlike playback.started/.ended (ITEM_ONLY_TYPES), an admin who is not cleared for a restricted item still receives this, and the row they patch with it was already correctly redacted by GET /admin/sessions. Emitted only when the (status, suspendedByThrottle) pair ACTUALLY moved — this marks a transition, never a call.

previousStatus.description: The status the row carried immediately before this write. Mirrors PlaybackSessionStatus (packages/contract/openapi.yaml).

status.description: The status the row carries after this write.

suspendedByThrottle.description: The committed playback_sessions.suspended_by_throttle value at this transition — the same field AdminSession carries, and the one that tells the throttle's healthy park apart from a heartbeat-stale suspend. Always false while `status` is anything other than `suspended`.

reason.description: Which worker-owned write moved the row: the pipeline claiming the session ('pipeline-starting') or reaching its first produced segment ('pipeline-active'), the segment-ahead throttle parking or resuming it, a seek target being claimed, or a restart clearing a throttle park (docs/PLAYBACK.md §9 'Restart hygiene').
